Frustrated fuel oil continues to speak.

#oott

I am in the media now, finally.

Yours truly,
Frustrated Fuel Oil

The North Sea market continues to benefit from expensive freight, inflating the cost of Dated Brent versus other physical grades. Notable: CPC, the flagship export grade from Kazakhstan, was offered today at a record discount of almost -$10 a barrel to Brent.

Saudi Arabia has been exporting crude so far this month at a rate that suggests the kingdom has lifted its oil production toward the 9-10 million b/d range.

Using both the Persian Gulf and (more importantly) the Red Sea, Riyadh has boosted crude exports during the first 22 days of October to >7 million b/d, reaching pre-war levels (see @Vortexa chart below). Adding clean and dirty refined product, the export flow Oct 1-22 reaches ~8.5m b/d, slightly below pre-war levels of >9m b/d. 

The crude export surge -- and the production boost -- could be part of a "use-while-you-can" strategy aimed at pumping ahead of the potential restart of the war post US midterms (or before the Houthis of Yemen damage another key oil installation -- several near misses already in recent days, including an attack that killed two contractors near a major oilfield).

Note: using Oct 1-2 as typically it takes at least five days for dark transits across the SoH to become clear.

Readout call of the call between Russia's President Purin and President of Finland Stubb,and the Prime Minister of Norway Géré

An exchange of views on the settlement of the Ukrainian crisis, taking into account the negotiations of Vladimir Putin with US President's Special Envoy Steven Witkoff in St. Petersburg on October 21 and contacts Alexander Stubb and Jonas Gara Støre with S. Witkoff and V. Zelensky in Oslo.

The interlocutors welcomed Agreement on the resumption of Abu Dhabi in the first half of November trilateral negotiations between Russia, Ukraine and the United States, aimed, in particular, at the issues of ensuring the security of Russia and Ukraine after the full End of hostilities.

Vladimir Putin gave an assessment the current situation in the conflict zone in Ukraine, recalling its root causes. It is emphasized that the achievement of a just long-term peace is possible only with full and unconditional accounting of legitimate interests of the Russian Federation. At This draws attention to the confrontational policy of the EU and NATO countries, leading to the prolongation of hostilities.

Questions were raised ensuring security and stability in the Baltic Sea and North regions Europe. The President of Finland and the Prime Minister of Norway confirmed in this regard The importance of respecting international maritime law and the principle of freedom Shipping.

President of Russia informed about the beginning of the humanitarian operation conducted through the mediation of the United States in the area of the Russian settlement of Alyoshki and the introduction of a temporary temporary for this purpose "Silence mode" in the Kherson direction.

Leaders of three countries agreed to continue to maintain direct contact by telephone.

COT report go twice-weekly from December.
The Commodity Futures Trading Commission plans to double the frequency with which it publishes a widely followed report on futures and options trading positions.
The Commitment of Traders report, currently released every Friday afternoon, gives an overview of trading positions in derivatives for energy and commodities, as well as for currencies, equity indices and interest rates.
Starting in December, the CFTC will publish the report every Wednesday and Friday at 3:30 p.m. New York time, according to a Tuesday statement.
